Comments on the draft are below.

The protocol should allow a receiving participant to verify a particular
relationship across administrative and trust boundaries while minimising
unnecessary disclosure of delegation history and participant information.

The protocol should distinguish between:

   - Verification of an individual parent-to-child relationship.
   - Verification of a complete delegation or propagation chain.
   - Verification based on partial provenance.
   - Disclosure of the identities of all participants in the interaction
   path.

Regards,
Alex
